title: Align Terraform and release workflow to the CodeBuild signer contract
expected_outcome: Terraform and the release workflow implement the reviewed immutable source archive and verification-output contract, while the signer remains disabled until a separately authorized image publish and infrastructure rollout.
constraints: Do not apply Terraform, publish images, create S3 objects, start CodeBuild, access Vault/AWS/EKS, or alter secrets.
Require a digest-pinned signer image and preserve disabled-by-default behavior.
Do not introduce static credentials, raw Transit signatures, or public Vault access.

primary_owner.responsibility: release-integrity and infrastructure security decisions, integration, final sign-off

acceptance_checks: reuse existing CodeBuild source mismatch and signer-contract evidence
delegations.escalation_trigger: live AWS state or a secret is required
implementation would apply Terraform, publish a container, access AWS/Vault, or require an unavailable signer image digest
